text:
Type: white linen cushion
Use: on a sofa, an armchair or a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, coastal
Materials: washed linen-blend fabric with a soft slub weave, simple flat seams
Colors: bright white, warm off-white
Shape: plain square cushion with clean straight edges, gently crumpled texture, full and plump, classic sofa size
Feel: fresh, light, airy, calm
Goes with: grey, beige or blue sofas, natural wood, mixed neutral cushions; Scandinavian, coastal or minimalist rooms

product.name: VIGDIS
product.description: The cushion cover is made of ramie, a hard-wearing natural material with a slightly irregular texture.
